distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2023) reports Immanus from China for the first time and describes Immanus songi from the Jinuo Mountains, Xishuangbanna, Yunnan. This establishes confirmed mainland-China occurrence in Yunnan.

host_note: The holotype was collected using a flight intercept trap in fragmented primary forest. The source reports biology as unknown and gives no host plant; no host taxon is inferred from habitat context.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Immanus songi Lin, Li & Meng, 2023.

taxonomic_history.name: Immanus songi
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Immanus songi Lin, Li & Meng was described as a new species in 2023 and represents the first record of the genus Immanus from China. Original-description evidence maps directly to existing integrated taxonomic backbone identity VSN_3378.
